name: Hall Leys Park Play Area and Splash Pad
description: Play area with some accessible play equipment and an interactive splash pad (open daily 10.30am to 5.30pm, April to September), in a town-centre park with wide level paths and a café. The main toilets by the Causeway Lane entrance have a separate accessible toilet and a baby changing toilet (8.30am to 5.30pm); there are more toilets inside the children's play area.
